_comment: Vetted third-party skills/MCP servers that Minecraft Studio can install via /mc-setup. Each entry was checked on GitHub (exists, licence, recent activity). We only LINK to these projects; nothing is copied. Re-check with: python scripts/registry_check.py (from the plugin root)

entries.purpose: Deep reference for FTB Quests SNBT: tasks, rewards, styling, KubeJS custom rewards.
Resource pack internals: pack.mcmeta, models, blockstates, sounds, fonts, animations.
entries.install: npx -y skills add Jahrome907/minecraft-agent-skills --skill minecraft-resource-pack --agent claude-code -y

entries.purpose: Vanilla datapacks: advancements, functions, loot tables, tags, recipes, worldgen.
entries.install: npx -y skills add Jahrome907/minecraft-agent-skills --skill minecraft-datapack --agent claude-code -y

entries.purpose: Pack icons, banners, thumbnails, texture concepts and UI mockups.
entries.install: npx -y skills add Jahrome907/minecraft-agent-skills --skill minecraft-imagegen --agent claude-code -y

entries.purpose: Writing mods (Fabric, NeoForge, Forge): code, assets, Gradle builds. Needed only for custom mods.
entries.install: npx -y skills add Jahrome907/minecraft-agent-skills --skill minecraft-modding --agent claude-code -y

entries.purpose: One codebase for Fabric + NeoForge (Architectury / multiloader).
entries.install: npx -y skills add Jahrome907/minecraft-agent-skills --skill minecraft-multiloader --agent claude-code -y

entries.purpose: Vanilla core shaders (GLSL inside a resource pack). Only for custom vanilla effects; Iris shaderpacks don't need it.
entries.install: claude plugin marketplace add dorondo0000/minecraft-core-shaders-skill && claude plugin install minecraft-core-shaders@mc-core-shaders

entries.purpose: Extra modpack/migration/debug skills (minecraft-modpack, minecraft-migrate, minecraft-debug). Young project: review before use.
Lets Claude create Prism Launcher instances, install mods, launch the game, read logs and screenshots. Destructive tools require confirm:true.
entries.install: git clone https://github.com/KeiNodens/prismlauncher-mcp && cd prismlauncher-mcp && npm install && npm run build && claude mcp add prism -- node <ABSOLUTE_PATH>/prismlauncher-mcp/dist/index.js

entries.purpose: Model, texture, animate and export Blockbench models from Claude. GPL-3.0: fine to use, don't copy its code into this MIT repo.
Desktop app that translates mods, FTB Quests and Patchouli books with an LLM.

rejected.reason: Repo only ships signed binaries, no licence, no source to review.
No licence. Revisit for v2 (mod creation).
Useful web tool, not an agent skill. Linked in docs only.
